descriptionChirho: A stern verbal censure or threatening reproof, often divine; all 11 clusters reflect the same meaning across all 6 languages (eng 'rebuke/threat', spa 'reprensión/amenaza', hin 'डाँट/घुड़की', arb 'تَوْبيخ/زَجْرَة/انْتِهَار', kor '꾸짖음', swa 'karipio/kukemea'), with variation only in grammatical inflection (construct/absolute state, pronominal suffixes, prepositional prefixes).
